# The Old Mark

*The Sea Slaters have eaten the tar off the old leading mark in the Saltface. Clear 60 of them from the Wrack Ledges so a crew can tar it fresh.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 [Sea Slater](../monsters/sea_slater.md) in [The Wrack Ledges](../maps/wrack_ledges.md)
